mapper.insert: INSERT INTO waiting_queue (patient_id, sch_id, apply_time, status) VALUES (#{patientId}, #{scheduleRecordId}, NOW(), '排队中')
mapper.select: SELECT id, patient_id, sch_id, apply_time, status FROM waiting_queue WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND sch_id = #{scheduleRecordId} ORDER BY apply_time ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM waiting_queue WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND sch_id = #{scheduleRecordId} AND status = '排队中'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM waiting_queue w JOIN doc_schedule_record dsr ON w.sch_id = dsr.id WHERE w.patient_id = #{patientId} AND to_char(dsr.schedule_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = #{date}

SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM waiting_queue w WHERE w.sch_id = #{scheduleRecordId} AND w.status = '排队中' AND w.apply_time < ( SELECT apply_time FROM waiting_queue WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND sch_id = #{scheduleRecordId} ORDER BY apply_time LIMIT 1 )
SELECT id, patient_id, sch_id, apply_time, status FROM waiting_queue WHERE sch_id = #{scheduleRecordId} AND status = '排队中' ORDER BY apply_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE waiting_queue SET status = '已取消' WHERE id = #{waitingId}
UPDATE waiting_queue SET status = '待支付', registration_id = #{registrationId} WHERE id = #{waitingId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM doc_schedule_record WHERE id = #{scheduleRecordId}
SELECT left_source_count FROM doc_schedule_record WHERE id = #{scheduleRecordId}
SELECT rule_value FROM waiting_rule WHERE rule_name = #{ruleName}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alternate_record WHERE sch_id = #{schId} AND status = '候补中'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alternate_record WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND status = '候补中'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alternate_record WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND sch_id = #{schId} AND status = '候补中'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alternate_record (patient_id, sch_id, status, waiting_time, position) VALUES (#{record.patientId}, #{record.schId}, #{record.status}, #{record.waitingTime}, #{record.position})
mapper.select: SELECT patient_id AS patientId, sch_id AS schId, status, waiting_time AS waitingTime, promoted_time AS promotedTime, expired_time AS expiredTime, position, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM alternate_record WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY waiting_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE alternate_record SET status = '已取消', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND sch_id = #{schId} AND status = '候补中'
mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT(to_char(dsr.schedule_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), ' ', to_char(st.start_time, 'HH24:MI:SS'))::timestamp FROM doc_schedule_record dsr JOIN schedule_template st ON dsr.template_id = st.id WHERE dsr.id = #{schId}

SELECT patient_id AS patientId, sch_id AS schId, status, waiting_time AS waitingTime, position, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM alternate_record WHERE sch_id = #{schId} AND status = '候补中' ORDER BY waiting_time ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT patient_id AS patientId, sch_id AS schId, status, waiting_time AS waitingTime, promoted_time AS promotedTime, expired_time AS expiredTime, position, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM alternate_record WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND sch_id = #{schId}
